name: Ring of Summoning Djinni
body:
Aura strong conjuration; CL 17th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of djinni calling. When the ring’s power is activated, the wearer vanishes and appears in the oasis residence of a djinni noble who will give her a task to complete; a successful DC 15 Will save avoids the compulsion to complete the task and leaves the decision of whether to accept the task or not to the wearer.

If the wearer accepts the task, she reappears at her point of origin and has one week to complete the task. Once the task is completed, the wearer reappears in front of the summoning djinni noble and the ring crumbles to dust. The former wearer is given a gift in return for his services (valued at no more than 2,000 GP) and returned to her point of origin.

If the task is refused, the djinni noble views the response as an insult and attacks. Additionally, if the task is not completed within the one week window, the wearer appears in front of the summoning djinni noble and the failure at accomplishing the task is viewed as an insult with similar effect.

In either case, if the djinni noble is defeated or driven off, the wearer reappears at her point of origin. If the djinni noble is slain, the ring crumbles to dust. If the djinni noble survives the attack, however, the ring remains intact and can only be removed by a wish spell. Additionally, the wearer is then targeted by that djinni noble for revenge until the ring is successfully removed or the djinni noble is killed.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of djinni calling

Identification DC 42
False Identification DC 32
